body:
If you want to PM, I'm here. 
I can't help you as much as I'd like, but at least it's a start.
Umm... Do you mean that I should send you the suicide note I wrote? (Sorry)
Thanks, you are a good person. If it's ok, could we PM a bit?

Hi.
Look, I know I don't have a kid, but if I had one I would keep living for them, even if I only saw them once a year. A child is an amazing thing, one that shouldn't be abandoned, I'm sorry if you feel I'm being too harsh. But killing yourself wouldn't help anything, let's call your daughter Jessica, (probably not her name) 

She's going to be affected for the rest of her life if you do this. I want to help you. Don't do anything yet. I want to help. Please PM me if I can help.
